$doc: out/factory/readiness.json — READINESS AUDIT, generated by tools/gen_readiness.py from out/factory/measure/*.json and the repo's data files. Grades: READY TO BUILD FROM / NOT YET / CANNOT DETERMINE. Every row carries the measurement and the file it was read from.

doc.title: Readiness audit
doc.sub: Artifact by artifact: can a factory that has never seen this repository build from this file today? READY TO BUILD FROM or NOT YET, with the measurement behind each grade, and for every NOT YET, what is missing and whether an agent closes it tonight or a person must.
doc.sub_zh: 逐个文件审核：一家从未见过本仓库的工厂，今天能否直接按此文件制造？每项给出“可直接制造”或“尚未就绪”，附测量依据；对每个“尚未就绪”项，说明缺什么、今晚由软件代理完成还是必须由人完成。
